dct_description_sm: We recorded mammal tracks and vegetation in key wildlife areas in Wemindji Territory to examine wildlife habitat associations and assemblages. We compared mammal tracks from roadside sites to key wildlife areas Cree hunters identified for environmental protection. This work is part of a SSHERC CURA (Community University Research Alliance) project aiming at the creation of a culturally appropriate protected in the Paakumshumwaau and Maatuskaau watersheds.
dct_subject_sm: Social sciences, economics and policy -> Traditional Ecological Knowledge (TEK)
dct_title_s: Winter tracking surveys of mammals across Wemindji Territory, James Bay, Quebec
